caption: Madonna del Sasso, Orselina
composition: Madonna del Sasso on its rock above Locarno and Lake Maggiore · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Madonna del Sasso stands on a rock spur in Orselina, a church and arcaded terrace above the roofs of Locarno and Lake Maggiore, with mountains on the far shore. The view stays outside and does not enter the sanctuary or feature a devotional image, and Piazza Grande remains a separate Locarno scene. Palms and late-September green remain on the Ticino slope. The Open-Meteo model sets the light.
